key_idea: Because the king is never first, the first position whose value is not exactly one more than its predecessor is the king.
sketch: Scan each group left to right and output the 1-based index of the first i with a[i] != a[i-1] + 1. The king can never accidentally equal predecessor+1, since then the following non-king would break the consecutive property of the remaining gnomes. O(g) per group.
